1.content:
## Problem MTTR Analysis
Track **Mean Time to Resolve** for Davis AI-detected problems across your environment. All tiles use the **dashboard time picker** — set to 30–90 days for meaningful trend data. Only **CLOSED**, non-duplicate problems are included in MTTR calculations.

**Categories:** `AVAILABILITY`  ·  `ERROR`  ·  `SLOWDOWN`  ·  `RESOURCE_CONTENTION`  ·  `CUSTOM_ALERT`

2.title: Closed Problems
2.query:
fetch dt.davis.problems
| filter not(dt.davis.is_duplicate) and event.status == "CLOSED"
| summarize total_problems = count()

3.title: Avg MTTR (hours)
3.query:
fetch dt.davis.problems
| filter not(dt.davis.is_duplicate) and event.status == "CLOSED"
| fieldsAdd duration_hours = toLong(event.end - event.start) / 3600000000000
| summarize avg_mttr_hours = avg(duration_hours)

4.title: Median MTTR (hours)
4.query:
fetch dt.davis.problems
| filter not(dt.davis.is_duplicate) and event.status == "CLOSED"
| fieldsAdd duration_hours = toLong(event.end - event.start) / 3600000000000
| summarize median_mttr_hours = percentile(duration_hours, 50)

5.title: P95 MTTR (hours)
5.query:
fetch dt.davis.problems
| filter not(dt.davis.is_duplicate) and event.status == "CLOSED"
| fieldsAdd duration_hours = toLong(event.end - event.start) / 3600000000000
| summarize p95_mttr_hours = percentile(duration_hours, 95)

6.content:
### Resolution Performance by Category
Average MTTR and problem distribution broken down by problem type. High MTTR in `AVAILABILITY` suggests infrastructure incidents are slow to remediate; high `ERROR` volume often indicates code-level regressions.

7.title: Avg MTTR by Category (hours)
7.query:
fetch dt.davis.problems
| filter not(dt.davis.is_duplicate) and event.status == "CLOSED"
| fieldsAdd duration_hours = toLong(event.end - event.start) / 3600000000000
| summarize avg_mttr_hours = avg(duration_hours), problem_count = count(), by: { event.category }
| sort avg_mttr_hours desc

8.title: Closed Problems by Category
8.query:
fetch dt.davis.problems
| filter not(dt.davis.is_duplicate) and event.status == "CLOSED"
| summarize problem_count = count(), by: { event.category }
| sort problem_count desc

9.content:
### MTTR Trend Over Time
Weekly average resolution time per category. A **downward slope** indicates your team is resolving problems faster. Spikes may indicate incidents that were difficult to diagnose or required escalation. Recommend setting the time picker to **90+ days** for a meaningful trend.

10.title: Weekly Avg MTTR by Category (hours)
10.query:
fetch dt.davis.problems
| filter not(dt.davis.is_duplicate) and event.status == "CLOSED"
| fieldsAdd duration_hours = toLong(event.end - event.start) / 3600000000000
| summarize avg_mttr = avg(duration_hours), by: { week = bin(event.start, 7d), event.category }
| sort week asc

11.title: Weekly Problem Volume by Category
11.query:
fetch dt.davis.problems
| filter not(dt.davis.is_duplicate)
| summarize problem_count = count(), by: { week = bin(event.start, 7d), event.category }
| sort week asc

12.content:
### Problem Detail
**Top Root Cause Entities** — which services, hosts, or resources trigger the most problems. **Longest-Duration Problems** — individual closed problems sorted by resolution time, useful for identifying outliers that skew your MTTR.

13.title: Top Root Cause Entities
13.query:
fetch dt.davis.problems
| filter not(dt.davis.is_duplicate)
| filter isNotNull(root_cause_entity_name)
| summarize problem_count = count(), avg_mttr_hours = avg(toLong(event.end - event.start) / 3600000000000), by: { root_cause_entity_name, event.category }
| sort problem_count desc
| limit 20

14.title: Longest Duration Problems
14.query:
fetch dt.davis.problems
| filter not(dt.davis.is_duplicate) and event.status == "CLOSED"
| fieldsAdd duration_hours = toLong(event.end - event.start) / 3600000000000
| fields display_id, event.name, event.category, root_cause_entity_name, duration_hours, event.start
| sort duration_hours desc
| limit 20

15.content:
### MTTR Detail Table
Per-problem-title breakdown: average MTTR and occurrence count. Sort by `avg_mttr_hours` descending to find which problem types are hardest to resolve. Sort by `problem_count` to find the most frequent issues.

16.title: MTTR by Problem Name
16.query:
fetch dt.davis.problems
| filter not(dt.davis.is_duplicate) and event.status == "CLOSED"
| fieldsAdd duration_hours = toLong(event.end - event.start) / 3600000000000
| summarize avg_mttr_hours = avg(duration_hours), problem_count = count(), by: { event.name, event.category }
| sort avg_mttr_hours desc
| limit 50
